title: Revision R3: thirty one-at-a-time trait-coefficient perturbations on the revised calibration

perturbations.note: lf has a negative curvature coefficient (-1.43); +/-10% keeps the sign. T0/Tm are absolute shifts in deg C. Same design as exp_t14_trait_robustness, different numerical specification.

acceptance: Descriptive sensitivity at one conditional calibration point. The 30 variants are not a probability sample of trait uncertainty and give no interval.
